items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: John worked with me at one point later on, after I’d been in the Hickory House.

ctx.x: John worked with me at one point later on, after I’d been in the Hickory House. I really loved his playing. He worked with me in St. Louis . . . other places too. But not for long. He was tempermental.
